description: Shows "Coding" as your FUDISLTE status while you work in VS Code. Off until you turn it on; shares only the fields you choose.
config.serverUrl: Address of your organization's FUDISLTE server, for example `https://chat.example.com`. Set by **FUDISLTE: Connect**. Only `https://` is accepted (`http://` only for `localhost`), and only user settings are read, so a workspace can never send your token elsewhere.
config.enabled: Show **Coding** as your FUDISLTE status while you actively work in VS Code. Off by default; only your user settings can turn it on.
config.shareProject: Add the name of the workspace folder you are working in (for example `fudislte-api`) to the status text. Folder names that look like paths are never sent.
config.shareLanguage: Add the language of the active editor (for example `TypeScript`) to the status text.
config.idleMinutes: Minutes without activity in VS Code after which the status is cleared.
